description: Dismiss a threshold suggestion the coach has decided against — "FTP looks like 262 W, not 250" when they know the test ride was a one-off — as the profile's Dismiss does. It stops counting toward the athlete's attention and stops appearing in the bell, until the evidence moves to a different number. Pass the finding as list_athletes' attention.thresholdAudit or get_weekly_review's threshold_audit gives it (metric, direction, current, suggested).

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

name: dismiss_threshold_finding
